rules.barge_in: tools/voice_mode.py _BargeDetector, built as full_duplex_listen builds it

stop_phrase.name: a_sentence_starting_with_stop_is_sent
stop_phrase.transcript: stop doing that and try again

use: one fresh detector per agent turn, armed when the user's message is sent, before any reply plays
each 30 ms block: keep it in the pre-roll (the last pre_roll_ms of blocks), then feed its RMS and whether the agent's voice is playing; the first phase returned is the trip

after a trip: stop the agent (its voice in playback, its turn in generation), then keep the pre-roll plus every following block until endpoint_silence_ms of blocks under silence_rms_threshold, or max_utterance_ms, and transcribe that

the transcript: an exact stop phrase ends the call; else, for a playback trip only, an echo of the last whole reply spoken is dropped (hermes_cli/cli_voice_mixin.py _voice_submit_barge_utterance); else it is sent, marked interrupted
